_comment: Append these two objects to the `datasets` array in D:\Work\GDA\v1\DataSchema.json (schemaVersion 3.0.0). Do NOT paste this wrapper object, only the two entries below.

parquet.notes: Long/tidy, one row per phase. Cols: ts_utc(datetime UTC), node_id(str, random - not personal), phase(L1|L2|L3|1p), ts_source(device|ha_receive|gps), voltage_v, current_a, power_w, power_factor, frequency_hz(node-global), phase_angle_deg(T3/PMU, P2), device_type, firmware, cadence_ms, loc_tier(anon|region|data_share), loc_ref(derived GSP-group/substation - NEVER a postcode). Plus provenance year/week/database. PRIVACY CONTRACT: rows carry no postcode, lat/lon, token, or contributor identity by construction (server allow-list projection). Pre-calibration frequency has unknown clock offset - treat as source='gridwitness', down-weight until NESO self-sync calibration lands.

entries.displayName: GridWitness crowd weather stations (HA nodes, Meteostat-shaped)

parquet.notes: Meteostat-shaped ground observations so it joins GDA's weather cell world. Cols: time(datetime UTC - note 'time', not ts_utc), node_id, ts_source, temp(C), rhum(%), wspd(km/h), wdir(deg met 'from'), pres(hPa), prcp(mm), solar_radiation_w_m2(W/m2), uv(index - net-new vs GDA), device_type, loc_tier, loc_ref, cell_id(0.25deg grid, e.g. cell_51.375_-2.625; derived server-side). Plus provenance year/week/database. Complements ERA5/openmeteo reanalysis as denser real-world point obs; enables the currently-missing temperature<->demand link.
